test_MCP_config_reload_on_new_server: test the HermesCLI auto-reload when a new MCP server is added to config.yaml
test_MCP_config_reload_on_removed_server: test the HermesCLI auto-reload when an MCP server is removed from config.yaml
test_MCP_config_no_reload_on_no_change: test the HermesCLI does not reload when config mtime and mcp_servers are unchanged
test_MCP_config_no_reload_on_mtime_only: test the HermesCLI does not reload when only file mtime changes but mcp_servers is identical
test_MCP_config_throttle_skips_check: test the HermesCLI skips config check when called within CONFIG_WATCH_INTERVAL
